network.coverage_note: The evidence is almost entirely about the Kohila municipality (Kohila vald) government website, not the "Kohila Avatud Noortekeskus" (Kohila Open Youth Centre) itself. The youth centre is only mentioned as a menu link (L89, "Noortekeskused") with no dedicated page, address, staff list, or Erasmus+/international mobility information. No partners, campuses, or institution-specific contacts for the youth centre are present; contacts listed here are municipal officials whose remit may touch youth/education work, used as fallback since no named youth-centre staff appear anywhere in the evidence.
